rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for expressing a very great degree, as in being deeply concerned.

example.english: I am deeply worried about you.

rows.note: Use this when something extends or moves far downward or inward, including swimming at considerable depth.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sing4 lok6 dak1 hou2 sam1

rows.note: Use this when thinking, analysing, or considering something profoundly rather than superficially.

example.english: We need to analyse this issue deeply.
example.traditional: 我哋要深入咁分析呢個問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sam1 jap6 gam2 fan1 sik1 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
